sideEffects: None that breaks anything. git diff 3f9bb33..HEAD touches only decisions/RT-FIX-P5-toolchain.md, scripts/katex-assets.mjs, site/src/lib/openItemsReport.mjs, site/src/lib/unverifiedRegistry.ts (comment lines only) and the new site/tests/unit/report-prebuild-failure.test.ts. It leaves alone reference/, golden data, conventions, caps, CONTRACTS, root package.json (the prebuild line asserted by scripts.test.ts is unchanged), scripts/report.mjs and the lockfile. The 236 added lines contain no em-dash, en-dash, .only, .skip, xit or 'astro dev'. scripts/katex-assets.mjs is P0-A3's script and lies outside the toolchain files of the P4 fix; the decisions fragment records why it was used (it is the first prebuild command).

Wording note, already flagged in the fixer's handoff and not a regression: after a release build fails before the Astro build starts, the held report still carries the earlier build's generatedAt. Both the refusal 'comes from a release build that did not finish' and the Markdown line 'the release build that wrote this report has not finished (or failed)' describe the later failed build, not the build that wrote the report. Tests assert 'did not finish'.
